comment: No source is published and the plugin ships no documentation, so this entry is built from the rendered panel, the parameter ranges in the census and the maker's product page. The panel prints FREQUENCY, BANK, COARSE over FINE, WAVE, BITCRUSH, WAVE CV, CV LEVEL, SUB with three marked positions, and the jacks 1V/OCT, WAVE CV, CV IN, SUB OUT and OUT; the maker configured no names for any of the five jacks, so the panel is the only source for them. Index order is not panel order here: input 2 is 1V/OCT on the left and input 0 is CV IN in the middle. The ranges corroborate the panel: WAVE runs 0 to 15 for the 16 waves in a bank, SUB has three positions, and BANK and COARSE are both two-state. The four bank lamps are drawn on the panel as a four-way bracket, which matches the 16 wavetables the maker's page claims. The context menu items CV to FM, CV to VCA, CV to Bank and CV to Crush are the maker's own. Not confirmed, and so not written: the hardware manual's -1 octave, -2 octave and squared waves for the three SUB positions; the hardware's 30Hz to 5kHz frequency range and -5V to 5V output; and what the saved phase_lock flag in the patch does, which no menu item in this build appears to reach.
